title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement:
Consider the operation \(*\) defined by the following table:

\[\begin{array}{c|cccc} * & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 & 4 & 1 & 3 \\ 3 & 3 & 1 & 4 & 2 \\ 4 & 4 & 3 & 2 & 1 \end{array}\]

For example, \(3 * 2 = 1.\) Then \((2 * 4) * (1 * 3) =\)

solutions.text:
From the table, \(2 * 4 = 3\) and \(1 * 3 = 3.\)

Then \((2 * 4) * (1 * 3) = 3 * 3 = 4.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Read \(2 * 4\) from row \(2,\) column \(4,\) and \(1 * 3\) from row \(1,\) column \(3\)
Both inner values equal \(3,\) so compute \(3 * 3\) from the table
